name: Bridgewell Cowbell
explanation: Modelled on the Roland TR-808 from its Service Notes; the same circuit model as inside Bridgewell 80, on its own so it gets its own mixer channel. Two free-running square oscillators at 540 and 800 Hz, gated and band-passed, with the circuit's two-stage envelope: an abrupt drop after the strike, then a ringing tail.
